pages.text: Explore fresh Overworld terrain for the colossal hive. Break through its defenders and attack the living core in Prototype mode. Collect the living hive tissue and operation intel. One grows a passage; the other identifies the sector to search in Futian.

Save your first tissue for the $(l:gateway)Hydra passage$(/l). Extra tissue goes into syringe culture, building infection cores or the weave nest. See $(l:apex)The Supreme Hunter$(/l) for the separate boss route.
